subject: POC onboarding playbook: access checklist & sprint owners
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: POC onboarding playbook: access checklist & sprint owners

Hi Olivia — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the POC next week: 

Success criteria (what Horizon will measure)
- Latency: p95 inference < 300ms for 512-token requests
- Cost: avg token cost target <= $0.004 per token for evaluation workload
- Quality: passthrough on the 50-item prompt set (>= 85% relevance)
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate at expected concurrency (20 req/s)

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Aug 31: Redwood provides access + onboarding docs
- Sept 2–9: Horizon runs smoke tests and baseline evaluation; daily quick syncs
- Sept 10: Joint review of metrics and decision window

Access items we need from Redwood (action owners on our side noted)
- SSO invite (SAML) for Horizon admin (Horizon to confirm admin email) — owner: Marissa
- Temporary API key scoped for evaluation (14-day TTL) — owner: Lauren
- IP allowlist template for your infra team to complete — attached and owner: Marissa
- SOC2/TAC evidence request (Horizon security asked about audit logs) — putting Marissa on the thread to share links

Olivia — can you confirm: 1) who should receive the SSO admin invite, and 2) whether Sept 2 start works for you?

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.md (detailed checklist)

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@horizonretail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Horizon Retail Security <security@horizonretail.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:10:12 -0700
Subject: Re: POC onboarding playbook: access checklist & sprint owners

Thanks Vivek — this is exactly what we needed. Confirming the following: 

1) SSO admin: me (Olivia Turner) — please send invite to olivia.turner@horizonretail.com
2) Timeline: Sept 2 start is perfect; we'll aim for a baseline by Sept 9

On security: our security team (security@horizonretail.com) requires the IP allowlist file and a document describing how temporary keys are issued/rotated. Also please include SOC2 artifact links or an evidence checklist.

Please send the SSO invite and IP template; we'll fill the template and return it to you. For API keys, we prefer a short-lived key delivered via a secure channel (1Password shared secret or encrypted link).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — speak soon.

— Olivia Turner
Director, Applied ML — Horizon Retail

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC onboarding playbook: access checklist & sprint owners

Lauren / Marissa — please action below (copy to Olivia when ready):

Lauren: create a temporary API key scoped to inference:read, inference:write, expiry 14 days. Mark as eval-only and attach the key to an internal message (do NOT paste the key into the external thread). We'll deliver the key to Olivia via 1Password shared secret after internal review.

Marissa: generate and send the SSO (SAML) invite to olivia.turner@horizonretail.com and attach the IP allowlist template (ip-allowlist-template.csv). Also include SOC2 evidence links (use the internal folder link below).

I'll send a single external reply once both items are staged. Also add the onboarding runbook link in the message for Horizon to follow.

Internal references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleOnboarding
Thanks,
Vivek

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 17:05:30 -0700
Subject: RE: POC onboarding playbook: access checklist & sprint owners

Done — temp key created and attached to this internal reply. Details: TTL 14 days, scopes: inference:read, inference:write, label: HR-POC-eval-temp. Key is stored in our secrets vault and the file temp-api-key.txt contains retrieval instructions (not the key itself).

Attachment: temp-api-key.txt (internal only)

If Marissa confirms SSO invite sent, I'll prepare the 1Password item and hand off the retrieval link to you for external delivery, Vivek.

— Lauren
Technical Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC onboarding playbook: access checklist & sprint owners

Olivia — thanks, all set to kick off on Sept 2. Quick update and what you'll receive in this message: 

What we've done
- SSO invite: sent to olivia.turner@horizonretail.com (you should see an email from Redwood SSO shortly) — Marissa is cc'd if you don't receive it within 10 minutes.
- IP allowlist template: attached (ip-allowlist-template.csv) — please complete and return to security@redwoodretail.com and cc me; we'll add your IPs to the eval pool.
- Temp API key: created with 14-day TTL; for security we will deliver the key via a 1Password shared item. Expected delivery: within 30 minutes after you confirm preferred recipient for secrets.
- SOC2/evidence: Marissa attached a short guide (SSO-invite-instructions.pdf) and links to our security folder for audit artifacts.

Next steps for Horizon
- Accept SSO invite and confirm admin access
- Fill IP allowlist template and send back by EOD Mon, Aug 31 if you want the IPs whitelisted before Sept 2
- Confirm preferred recipient for the 1Password secret (e.g., olivia.turner@horizonretail.com)

Attachments in this email: ip-allowlist-template.csv, SSO-invite-instructions.pdf

If anything is missing or your security team needs additional evidence, loop them in and I'll have Marissa follow up. Looking forward to the test run next week.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
